JavaScript enabled.</noscript><div id=\"___gatsby\"><div style=\"outline:none\" tabindex=\"-1\" role=\"group\" id=\"gatsby-focus-wrapper\"><nav class=\"navigation\"><a class=\"navigation__item navigation__home\" href=\"/blog/\"></a><div class=\"navigation__links\"><a href=\"https://developers.soundcloud.com\" class=\"navigation__item\">Developers</a><a class=\"navigation__item class=\"navigation__item\">Jobs</a></div></nav><div class=\"layout__container \"><h1 class=\"blogPost__title\">Moving to Modern Streaming: Introducing AAC HLS on SoundCloud APIs [Deadline Extended]</h1><p class=\"blogPost__metadata\">September 15th, 2025<!-- --> <!-- -->by <span>Youssef Hassan</span></p><div class=\"blogPost__content\"><p>At SoundCloud, we’re always looking for ways to improve the listening experience for our creators, partners, and listeners. One of the biggest improvements we can make is at the very core: the audio streams themselves.\nOver the years, our API has returned a set of streaming URLs based on MP3 and Opus formats. While these formats served us well, it’s time to modernize. To provide higher quality, more consistent playback, and better support across devices, we’re moving to AAC-based HLS streams.</p>\n<h2>🚀 What’s changing?</h2>\n<p>Starting today, the streams endpoint (/tracks/{track_urn}/streams) includes new HLS AAC transcodings:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>hls_aac_160_url (standard quality, preferred format and bitrate)</li>\n<li>hls_aac_96_url (alternative quality, depending on availability and can work as fallback to the 160k stream)</li>\n</ul>\n<p>For a transition period, existing fields like http_mp3_128_url, hls_mp3_128_url, and hls_opus_64_url will remain available.</p>\n<h2>⏳ Deadline Extended: Deprecation Timeline</h2>\n<p>We plan to remove Progressive HTTP, HLS MP3 and HLS Opus transcodings from our APIs on December 31, 2025.\nThe following fields will no longer be supported after that date:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>http_mp3_128_url (Progressive HTTP MP3) </li>\n<li>hls_mp3_128_url (HLS MP3)</li>\n<li>hls_opus_64_url (HLS Opus)</li>\n</ul>\n<p>preview_mp3_128_url will remain available for preview use cases.</p>\n<h2>✅ What you need to do</h2>\n<ul>\n<li>\n<p>Migrate from MP3 / Opus to AAC</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Replace http_mp3_128_url, hls_mp3_128_url, and hls_opus_64_url with the new AAC HLS streams.</li>\n<li>Use hls_aac_160_url (preferred) or hls_aac_96_url where available.</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p>Migrate from Progressive HTTP to HLS</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Progressive MP3 playback (http_mp3_128_url) will no longer be supported.</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Test your integration with the new URLs to ensure a smooth migration.</p>\n<h3>🔍 Example Response as of now</h3>\n<div class=\"gatsby-highlight\" data-language=\"text\"><pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">{\n\"http_mp3_128_url\": \"https://cf-media.sndcdn.com/trackid.128.mp3?...\",\n\"hls_mp3_128_url\": \"https://cf-hls-media.sndcdn.com/playlist/trackid.128.mp3/playlist.m3u8?...\",\n\"hls_aac_160_url\": \"https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_160k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...\",\n\"hls_opus_64_url\": \"https://cf-hls-opus-media.sndcdn.com/playlist/uuid.64.opus/playlist.m3u8?...\",\n\"preview_mp3_128_url\": \"https://cf-preview-media.sndcdn.com/preview/0/30/trackid.128.mp3?...\"\n}</code></pre></div>\n<h3>🔍 Example Response after Dec 31, 2025</h3>\n<div class=\"gatsby-highlight\" data-language=\"text\"><pre class=\"language-text\"><code class=\"language-text\">{\n\"hls_aac_160_url\": \"https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_160k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...\",\n\"hls_aac_96_url\": \"https://playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud/trackid/aac_96k/uuid/playlist.m3u8?...\",\n\"preview_mp3_128_url\": \"https://cf-preview-media.sndcdn.com/preview/0/30/trackid.128.mp3?...\"\n}</code></pre></div>\n<h2>💬 Feedback</h2>\n<p>We’d love to hear how the transition works for you. If you run into issues or need additional support, please open <a href=\"https://github.com/soundcloud/api/issues\">a discussion on GitHub</a>.\nThis change sets the foundation for better audio quality and playback reliability across SoundCloud integrations. We encourage you to migrate early and share your feedback.</p></div><aside class=\"blogPost__categories\"><ul class=\"categories\"><li class=\"categories__category\"><a class=\"categories__categoryLink\" href=\"/blog/category/api\">API</a></li><li class=\"categories__category\"><a class=\"categories__categoryLink\" href=\"/blog/category/announcement\">Announcement</a></li><li class=\"categories__category\"><a class=\"categories__categoryLink\" href=\"/blog/category/transcodings\">Transcodings</a></li><li class=\"entry-title\">The power of AI auto-tagging for music</h1>\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t<p class=\"post-meta\"> by <span class=\"author vcard\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/blog/author/jakob/\" title=\"Posts by Jakob\" rel=\"author\">Jakob</a></span> | <span class=\"published\">Nov 15, 2025</span> | <a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/category/smart-music-discovery/\" rel=\"category tag\">Smart Music et-l--post\">\n\t\t\t<div class=\"et_builder_inner_content et_pb_gutters3\">\n\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_section et_pb_section_0 et_section_regular\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_row et_pb_row_0\">\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_0  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><b>Ready to transform how you manage your catalog?</b> <span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" href=\"https://cyanite.ai/music-tagging/?utm_source=blog&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=ai-auto-tagging-music-catalogs-top\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><b>Start auto-tagging music with Cyanite</b></a></span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">We know managing a large music catalog can feel overwhelming. When metadata is inconsistent or incomplete, tracks become difficult to find and hard to work with. The result is a messy catalog that you have to sort out manually—unless you use AI auto-tagging.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Read more to see how automatic music tagging reduces friction and helps you organize your catalog more accurately.</span></p>\n<h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></h2>\n<h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></h2>\n<h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">What is automatic music tagging?</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Automatic music tagging is an audio analysis process that identifies a song’s mood, genre, energy, tempo, instrumentation, and other core attributes. A music analyzer AI listens to the track and applies these labels with consistent logic, providing stable metadata across your catalog.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">AI tagging supports teams that depend on fast, accurate search. For example, if you run a sync marketplace that needs to respond to briefs quickly, you can surface the right tracks in seconds when the metadata aligns with the sound you’re looking for. If you work at a production library with thousands of incoming submissions, you can review new material more efficiently when the system applies consistent labels from day one. The same applies to music-tech platforms that want stronger discovery features without having to build their own models.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h3><strong>Benefits of auto-tagging for music professionals</strong></h3>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">AI auto-tagging brings value across the music industry. When tracks enter your system with clear, predictable metadata, teams can work with more confidence and fewer bottlenecks, supporting smoother catalog operations overall.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Faster creative exploration</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Sync and production teams can filter and compare tracks more quickly during pitches, making it easier to deliver strong options under time pressure.</span><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>More reliable handoffs between teams</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">When metadata follows the same structure, creative, technical, and rights teams work from the same information without needing to reinterpret tags.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Improved rights and version management</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Publishers benefit from predictable metadata when preparing works for licensing, tracking versions, and organizing legacy catalogs.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Stronger brand alignment in audio branding</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Agencies working on global campaigns can rely on mood and energy tags that follow the same structure across regions, helping them maintain a consistent brand identity.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Better technical performance for music platforms</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">When metadata is structured from the start,</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">product and development teams see fewer ingestion issues, more stable recommendations, and smoother playlist or search behavior.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Greater operational stability for leadership</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Clear, consistent metadata lowers risk, supports scalability, and gives executives more confidence in the long-term health of their catalog systems.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h3>Why manual music tagging fails at scale</h3>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">There’s a time and a place for running a music catalog manually: if your track selection is small and your team has the capacity to listen to each song one by one and label them carefully. But as your catalog grows, that process will start to break down.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Tags can vary from person to person, and different editors will likely use different wording. Older metadata rarely matches newer entries. Some catalogs even carry information from multiple systems and eras, which makes the data harder to trust and use.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Catalog managers are not the only ones feeling this pain. This inconsistent metadata slows down the search for creative teams. Developers are also affected when this unreliable data disrupts user-facing recommendation and search features. So the more music you manage, the more this manual-tagging bottleneck grows.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h3>When human collaboration is still needed</h3>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">While AI can provide consistent metadata at scale, creative judgment still matters. People add the cultural context and creative insight that go beyond automated sound analysis. Also, publishers sometimes adapt tags for rights considerations or for more targeted sync opportunities.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The goal of AI auto-tagging is not to replace human input, but to give your team a stable foundation to build on. With accurate baseline metadata, you can focus on adding the context that carries strategic or commercial value.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_testimonial et_pb_testimonial_0 clearfix  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_testimonial_no_image\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_testimonial_description\" style=\"margin-left: 0px;\">\n\t\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_testimonial_description_inner\"><div class=\"et_pb_testimonial_content\"><p class=\"p1\"><i><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Cyanite has maybe most significantly improved our work with its Similarity Search that allows us to enhance our searches objectively, melting away biases and subjective blind spots that humans naturally have.</span></i></p></div></div>\n\t\t\t\t\t<span class=\"et_pb_testimonial_author\">William Saunders</span>\n\t\t\t\t\t<p class=\"et_pb_testimonial_meta\"><span class=\"et_pb_testimonial_position\">Co-Owner &amp; Creative Director</span><span class=\"et_pb_testimonial_separator\">,</span> <span class=\"et_pb_testimonial_company\">MediaTracks</span></p>\n\t\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">How does AI music tagging work at Cyanite?</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">At Cyanite, our approach to music analysis is fully audio-based. When you upload a track, </span><b>our </b><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/2020/09/30/the-4-essential-steps-for-analyzing-music-with-neural-networks/\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><b>AI analyzes only the sound</b></a></span><b> of the file—not the embedded metadata.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> Our model listens from beginning to end, capturing changes in mood, instrumentation, and energy across the full duration.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">We start by </span><b>converting the MP3 audio file into a spectrogram</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">, which turns the sound into a visual pattern of frequencies over time. This gives our system a detailed view of the track’s structure. From there, </span><b>computer vision models analyze the spectrogram</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> to detect rhythmic movement, instrument layers, and emotional cues across the song. After the analysis, the </span><b>model generates a set of tags</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> that describe these characteristics. We then </span><b>refine the output through post-processing</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> to keep the results consistent, especially when working with large or fast-growing catalogs.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">This process powers our </span><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/music-tagging\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">music tagging suite</span></a></span><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">, which includes two core products:</span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Auto-Tagging</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">identifies core musical attributes such as genre, mood, instrumentation, energy level, movement, valence–arousal position, and emotional dynamics. Each label is generated through consistent audio analysis, which helps maintain stable metadata across new and legacy material.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Auto-Descriptions</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: complement tags with short summaries that highlight the track’s defining features. These descriptions are created through our own audio models, without relying on any external language models. They give you an objective snapshot of how the music sounds, which supports playlisting, catalog review, and licensing workflows that depend on fast context.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_0_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module \">\n\t\t\t\t<a class=\"et_pb_button et_pb_button_0 et_pb_bg_layout_light\" API</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Everything you see in the </span><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://app.cyanite.ai/library\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><span Our system delivers a rich set of tags for the full track and for every 15-second segment, helping you map changes in energy, mood, instrumentation, and other key attributes.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">We convert each track into a spectrogram, apply computer vision to understand its musical structure, and refine the results through post-processing. This gives you a consistent metadata layer that supports curation, licensing, and catalog navigation at scale.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_9  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"><strong>Learn more:</strong> <span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RVMVcM47OfNWrO0KfF4_C5N52bH_vfrAHzdtPfhS_Jw/edit?gid=0#gid=0\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Explore our tagging taxonomy to see how our model works</a></span></span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The Cyanite API includes an interactive Query Builder that helps developers work with this metadata efficiently. You can use it to test queries, explore the full schema, and view example JSON outputs for every tag and attribute (global and segment-based). This makes it easy to map our tagging fields directly to your internal data model.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_1_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module \">\n\t\t\t\t<a class=\"et_pb_button et_pb_button_1 et_pb_bg_layout_light\" href=\"https://api-docs.cyanite.ai/docs/library-track-query-builder/\" target=\"_blank\" data-icon=\"5\">Check out the API query builder</a>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_10  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Music Similarity Search</span></h2></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_1\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Hard-Col.Element-135@Tagging.png\" class=\"et_pb_lightbox_image\" title=\"A screenshot showing the first steps needed to create an API integration\"><span class=\"et_pb_image_wrap \"><img decoding=\"async\" src=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Hard-Col.Element-135@Tagging.png\" alt=\"A screenshot showing the first steps needed to create an API integration\" title=\"Charli xcx - Apple Simi Search\" class=\"wp-image-17957\"></span></a>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_11  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Cyanite delivers similar-sounding songs for any reference audio file or YouTube link. You can upload a file or paste a link, and the system analyzes the track before comparing it to your music library. We also store the reference song in your library so you can choose which part of the track you want to base the search on. This lets you explore different segments—for example, the chorus and the verse—to find the best match.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">If you work with Spotify, you can also use Spotify track IDs. Once we’ve analyzed the standard 30-second preview, the results stay stored for faster retrieval in future searches.</span></p>\n<p><b>Read more: </b><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/2022/06/02/music-similarity-search-find-similar-songs/\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Best of music similarity search: find similar songs with the help of AI</a></span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_12  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Free Text Search</span></h2></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_2\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/FTS-Example.png\" class=\"et_pb_lightbox_image\" title=\"A screenshot showing the first steps needed to create an API integration\"><span class=\"et_pb_image_wrap \"><img decoding=\"async\" src=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/FTS-Example.png\" alt=\"A screenshot showing the first steps needed to create an API integration\" title=\"Cyanite Free Text Search Example\" class=\"wp-image-18303\"></span></a>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_13  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With </span><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/music-search/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Free Text Search</span></a></span><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">, you can write full sentences and let Cyanite interpret their meaning. The system understands the semantics of natural language, whether you describe a musical idea or the mood of a scene. This approach removes the usual constraints of music search and makes it easy for anyone to find the right tracks.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Here are some example prompts:</span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">“dark atmospheric strings with slow build-up”</span></li>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">“warm indie guitar with nostalgic mood”</span></li>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">“energetic Latin pop for a dance scene”</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"><b>Read more: </b><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/2023/11/24/how-to-prompt-using-cyanites-free-text-search/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\">How to prompt: the guide to using Cyanite’s Free Text Search</a></span></span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_14  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Advanced Search (Similarity &amp; Free Text Search add-on)</span></h2></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_3\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<a href=\"https://api-docs.cyanite.ai/docs/updating-audio-analysis-v7/\" target=\"_blank\"><span class=\"et_pb_image_wrap \"><img decoding=\"async\" width=\"1080\" height=\"675\" src=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Advanced-Search-Cover.png\" alt=\"A screenshot showing the first steps needed to create an API integration\" title=\"Advanced Search Update\" srcset=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Advanced-Search-Cover.png 1080w, https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Advanced-Search-Cover-980x613.png 980w, https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Advanced-Search-Cover-480x300.png 480w\" sizes=\"(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1080px, 100vw\" class=\"wp-image-18860\"></span></a>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_15  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/2025/07/15/advanced-search-update/\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\">Advanced Search</span></span></a><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> helps you and your users find the ideal track in your catalog based on your meticulously curated criteria and exact specifications. It’s an extended feature set that enhances </span><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/music-search/\"><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\">Similarity and</span> <span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\">Free Text Search</span></span></a><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> with custom filtering, ranking, and multi-reference capabilities. Advanced Search is ideal for platforms needing precision, ranking logic, hybrid search models, or complex business rules. Some of the key capabilities include:</span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Custom metadata upload</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Upload your own metadata fields (regions, rights, subcatalogs, cultural tags), and use them as filters in search queries.</span></li>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Similarity scores</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Retrieve normalized similarity scores for ranking and help users better understand and trust the search results at a glance.</span></li>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Multi-track search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Provide up to 50 reference tracks at once. The system merges their sonic profiles to deliver more accurate creative matches.</span></li>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Up to 500 ranked results</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Get deep catalog visibility—ideal for editorial teams and large platforms.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><b>Most similar segments</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Retrieve segment-level match information between reference and result.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_16  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2>Crates</h2></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_image and help keep large, complex catalogs manageable.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Use them to define focused subsets within your library so you can manage specific parts of the catalog with more precision. They also help you control access based on rights, support teams who only work with a particular portion of the catalog, and keep curated subcatalogs separate when needed. You can also run similarity searches within a crate, which is useful for segmented or specialized discovery workflows.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_2_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module \">\n\t\t\t\t<a class=\"et_pb_button et_pb_button_2 et_pb_bg_layout_light\" href=\"https://api-docs.cyanite.ai/docs/create-integration?utm_source=blog&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=music-analysis-api-button\" target=\"_blank\" data-icon=\"5\">Start your API integration</a>\n\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t</div>\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_row et_pb_row_2\">\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_18  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">How leading platforms have used our API</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The Cyanite API is already embedded into the workflows of leading music platforms, helping them power search, discovery, and catalog navigation. [&amp;_.progressive-markdown_:is(p,blockquote,ul,ol,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6)]:pr-8\">\n<div>\n<div class=\"standard-markdown grid-cols-1 grid [&amp;_&gt;_*]:min-w-0 gap-3 standard-markdown\">\n<p class=\"font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]\"><strong>See how Cyanite performs on your own catalog. <a class=\"text-text-300 flex items-stretch justify-between\">\n<div class=\"w-fit\" data-state=\"closed\">\n<div class=\"relative text-text-500 group-hover/btn:text-text-100\">\n<div class=\"absolute top-0 left-0 transition-all opacity-0 scale-50\">Many music catalogs are growing faster than manual workflows can handle. What used to be manageable with spreadsheets and human tagging now requires infrastructure that can make tens of thousands of tracks discoverable.</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">“AI tools for music” is one of the most searched terms in this space, but also one of the most misleading. Metadata generation, file management, distribution workflows, and search infrastructure each require different solutions. Choosing the wrong category is the most common reason implementations fail.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">This guide focuses specifically on AI tagging and search infrastructure, so you can evaluate your options based on how these systems actually work.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">What to look for in AI tagging and search infrastructure</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Not all AI music tools are designed for the same purpose. Before evaluating specific tools, it helps to understand what separates infrastructure-grade systems from standalone tools.</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Audio-based vs. metadata-based analysis</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Does the system analyze the audio signal directly, or rely on existing metadata and text inputs? Audio-based systems produce more consistent results, particularly for large or legacy catalogs where existing metadata is incomplete or unreliable.</span><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>Tagging quality and consistency</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Consistency matters more than coverage. A system that tags reliably at scale is more operationally valuable than one that only produces detailed results for some tracks.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>Search capabilities</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">:</span> <span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Look for similarity search based on a reference song, the ability to use multiple tracks as a reference, and free-text search that understands natural language prompts rather than requiring exact keyword matches.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>Control over discovery</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Good infrastructure lets you filter by tags or custom metadata, combine similarity search with business logic, and adjust ranking behavior based on your use case.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_6  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>API flexibility and integration depth</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: A system that cannot integrate cleanly into your existing pipelines doesn’t function as infrastructure. It’s a standalone tool.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_7  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>Catalog scale and processing performance</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Evaluate processing speed per track, batch handling capacity, and how smoothly the system onboards a large or legacy catalog.</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_8  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><ul>\n<li><b>Data security and ownership</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Consider the following questions: Is your audio processed locally or on third-party servers? Is your data used to train external AI models? How does the system handle unreleased content? Is it GDPR-compliant?</span></li>\n</ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_9  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">AI software for analyzing music at a Searches cover the full catalog, including alternate versions and submixes.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Similarity Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Finds tracks based on audio similarity to a reference. Accepts YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, and TikTok links, uploaded audio files, or tracks from within the catalog. Includes segment search, BPM prioritization, vocal ignore, and highlight markers that show where in a result the similarity is strongest.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Smart Projects and Dynamic Playlists</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Uses multiple reference tracks to establish a playlist theme and generates an ongoing stream of on-theme tracks that automatically updates as new music is added to the catalog.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Lyrics Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Finds music based on the meaning and sentiment of lyrics rather than exact word matches. For catalogs without existing lyric data, AIMS offers AudioShake’s transcription technology to generate lyrics automatically.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Video Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Matches music to a video clip that’s up to one minute long, analyzing visual tone, pace, and emotion.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Tagging</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Audio-based auto-tagging with support for custom tags, multiple languages, and export to DSPs and UGC platforms. The two operate as separate APIs that AIMS needs to connect on the backend.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>No similarity score is exposed via the API.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> Results are ranked by relevance but no numerical confidence value is returned, which limits developer control over how results are weighted or displayed in custom interfaces.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Teams integrating via API must build their own front-end interface from scratch.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> AIMS provides no UI component library for this purpose, though the demo application and code samples are available as reference.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Ranking behavior is fixed.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> Results are always sorted by descending similarity. Accepts descriptions of instrumentation, mood, tempo, and context, as well as sync briefs and reference artists.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Similarity Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Finds tracks based on audio similarity to one or more reference tracks. Accepts audio links and uploaded files, with segment selection to narrow the reference to a specific part of a track.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Lyrics Story Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Finds music based on the thematic meaning and narrative of lyrics rather than sonic qualities. Accepts keywords or a description of the story or emotional arc the song should convey.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Video Search</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">: Analyzes a video or image input and finds music that matches the mood and visuals.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_23  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h4><b>Harmix is best suited for…</b></h4>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The web platform suits internal sync teams and music supervisors who want immediate access to AI search without development resources.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Teams wanting to surface capabilities through their own platform or client-facing website will need developer capacity to integrate Harmix via API.</span></p>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_24  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h4><b>Limitations:</b><b></b></h4>\n<p><b></b></p>\n<p><b></b></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>No auto-tagging or AI music detection product.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> Harmix doesn’t offer standalone tagging or AI music detection infrastructure. Teams that need to generate or enrich metadata at scale require a separate solution for that workflow.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>Metadata does not affect search results.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> According to the API documentation, metadata fields are used only for filtering, not for influencing search relevance.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>File format and size constraints apply to audio uploads.</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"> Supported formats are MP3, WAV, and M4A, with a 120 MB file size limit.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\"></span></p>\n<ul>\n<li style=\"font-weight: 400;\" aria-level=\"1\"><b>The “Highlights” feature requires manual activation</b><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">. It shows which segment of a result is most similar to the reference, but it’s not enabled by default. Teams need to contact Harmix support to activate.</span></li>\n</ul>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_25  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h4><b>Pricing model:</b></h4>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Not publicly available but can be requested via a scheduled demo. Teams that want to test the product before committing can use a free trial. Harmix also runs a referral program for existing customers and partners, offering 100% of a referred client’s first-month fee as cash or account credit.</span></p>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_divider et_pb_divider_2 et_pb_divider_position_ et_pb_space\"><div class=\"et_pb_divider_internal\"></div></div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_26  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h3><a href=\"https://music.ai/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><strong>4. Music.AI</strong></a></h3>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Music.AI is an audio intelligence platform covering stem separation, chord recognition, beat detection, and lyrics transcription. Cyanite integrates with Music.AI as a third-party addition, making AI tagging accessible directly within Music.AI workflows without a separate integration.</span></p>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_27  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">AI infrastructure vs music CMS systems</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">A common source of confusion when evaluating music AI tools is the difference between AI tagging and search infrastructure vs. music content management systems. They solve different problems, and understanding that distinction helps clarify which category you actually need.</span></p>\n<ul></ul></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_1\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x.png\" class=\"et_pb_lightbox_image\" title=\"\"><span class=\"et_pb_image_wrap \"><img loading=\"lazy\" decoding=\"async\" width=\"1584\" height=\"990\" src=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x.png\" alt=\"\" title=\"AI infrastructure vs music CMS systems\" srcset=\"https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x.png 1584w, https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x-1280x800.png 1280w, https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x-980x613.png 980w, https://cyanite.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/CleanShot-2026-05-04-at-17.22.00@2x-480x300.png 480w\" sizes=\"(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) and (max-width: 1280px) 1280px, (min-width: 1281px) 1584px, 100vw\" class=\"wp-image-20740\"></span></a>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_28  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Bridge.audio is a good example of why this distinction matters. It’s a music workflow platform that combines catalog management, AI-assisted tagging, sync discovery, and file sharing in one place. Cyanite is different, since it focuses exclusively on the analysis and search layer, going deeper on tagging, sound-based search, and API-level infrastructure for embedding discovery into other products.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Cyanite is not a CMS, nor is it designed to replace one. For most organizations, the two categories work in combination: the CMS handles operations, and AI like Cyanite handles the intelligence layer that makes the catalog searchable.</span></p>\n<p><b>Read more: </b><span style=\"color: #cc99ff;\"><a href=\"https://cyanite.ai/2024/07/30/music_content_management_systems_with_cyanite/\" style=\"color: #cc99ff;\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><b>Music CMS solutions compatible with Cyanite</b></a></span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">&nbsp;</span></p></div>\n\t\t\t</div><div class=\"et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_29  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark\">\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t<div class=\"et_pb_text_inner\"><h2><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">So, which tool is right for you?</span></h2>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The right system depends on what your core workflow actually requires.</span></p>\n<p><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">If your catalog is hard to search, the issue is rarely search itself, but the metadata powering it.
